note: The turn where they answered a question he asked. Not an acknowledgement and not another question about them: an engaged follow-up on the thing they just said. Generic on purpose -- there is no parser here, so the lines have to work for 'playing video games', 'i sorted the garage out' and 'i am reading a book about trains' alike, which is what a person does too. Reachable only when he asked the previous question, so it cannot be used to interrogate somebody who was simply talking.

variants: oh nice. how is it going?
how long have you been at that?
